query:
WITH drained AS (
            DELETE FROM credit_charge_queue
             WHERE invocation_id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT invocation_id FROM credit_charge_queue
                                              ORDER BY invocation_id
                                              LIMIT $1
                                              FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED))
            RETURNING 1
        ), drained_calls AS (
            DELETE FROM call_charge_queue
             WHERE id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM call_charge_queue
                                   ORDER BY id
                                   LIMIT $1
                                   FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED))
            RETURNING 1
        )
        SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM drained) + (SELECT count(*) FROM drained_calls)
            AS "drained!"
